summary: CORTEX is a generative FM instrument that plays evolving chords by itself, with a tape loop and a video synth on the screen. Forked from AMB-1.
features: Three six-operator FM voices (pad, bells, bass) with DX7 banks
Per-voice ADSR, Moog-style low-pass filter and five modulators
Tape reel records and replays the voices
Songs loaded from MIDI files into song slots
Screen video synth with twelve preset looks
On-screen cartoon cat explains each page and knob
